name: eta-redemption
title: Redemption (burn-to-pay)
notes:
• The vault validator pairs the spent vault with its continuation and requires the vault's net ADA loss to equal Σ decode(name) × burned exactly. A redeemer cannot ask for more than the coupons are worth, and the vault cannot short-pay.
• Exactly one vault is spent per redemption; the payout goes to the address(es) the redeemer names.
• The coupon is burned, so it can never be paid twice. No vault-owner signature is needed; the redeemer signs only to spend the coupon UTxO.
